classification.difficultyReason: Use inverse area formulas while identifying the corresponding perpendicular base-height pair in rotated parallelograms. Part f requires ignoring the unrelated 11 cm side and pairing z with the marked 9 cm perpendicular distance.

content.prompt: Find the missing side lengths in these shapes.

spec.description: Horizontal rectangle with its area inside and external horizontal and vertical dimension arrows.
spec.mathematics: A = lw; area 36 cm², horizontal side 9 cm, vertical side x cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied givens are visible; the answer 4 cm is excluded.

spec.description: Parallelogram with horizontal parallel edges, an area label, a horizontal base dimension and a vertical height dimension.
spec.mathematics: A = bh; base 6 cm, perpendicular height x cm, area 12 cm².
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied givens are visible; the answer 2 cm is excluded.

answer.worked:
The vertical dimension is the perpendicular height.
$$\begin{align*}A&=bh\\12&=6x\\12\div6&=6x\div6\\x&=2\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Tall parallelogram with vertical left and right sides and sloping top and bottom edges. The right side is labelled 20 cm; the horizontal separation is labelled x cm below. A dashed horizontal guide and right-angle marker establish the perpendicular height. This intentionally repairs the source geometry while preserving its givens and orientation.
spec.mathematics: A = bh; the vertical base is 20 cm, its horizontal perpendicular height is x cm, and the area is 100 cm². Thus 100 = 20x and x = 5 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied givens are visible; the answer 5 cm is excluded.

answer.worked:
Use the vertical side as the base and the horizontal perpendicular distance as the height.
$$\begin{align*}A&=bh\\100&=20x\\100\div20&=20x\div20\\x&=5\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Rotated rectangle with its bottom edge rising to the right. External dimension arrows follow the bottom and right edges.
spec.mathematics: A = lw; area 64 cm² and adjacent side lengths 8 cm and x cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied givens are visible; the answer 8 cm is excluded.

spec.description: Parallelogram with matching single and double parallel marks, a 9 cm top edge, an internal area label and a red dashed perpendicular height p with a right-angle marker.
spec.mathematics: A = bh; base 9 cm, perpendicular height p, area 63 cm².
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied givens are visible; the answer 7 cm is excluded.

spec.description: Diamond-oriented parallelogram with matching parallel marks. Side z is upper-left, 11 cm is lower-left, and a red dashed 9 cm perpendicular distance extends from the right vertex to the upper-left side.
spec.mathematics: A = bh; side z is the selected base and 9 cm is its corresponding perpendicular height. Area is 108 cm². The supplied 11 cm side remains visible.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied givens are visible; the answer 12 cm is excluded.

answer.worked:
The $9\text{ cm}$ height is perpendicular to side $z$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=bh\\108&=9z\\108\div9&=9z\div9\\z&=12\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
